sourceHash.description: Content address of the immutable source object, including its schema/kind envelope; not the raw file digest.

stateHash.description: Content address of the committed workspace or complete library state manifest.

sourceHash.description: Content address of the immutable source object, including its schema/kind envelope; not the raw file digest.

sources.description: Workspace object address to canonical workspace-data digest; exact source byte objects are listed in manifest.sources.

commandGroupId.description: Stable command identity for selected Scratch notes and verified value records. Legacy root records can be addressed through their current-view group.

sourceValueHash.description: Hash of the immutable archived container before the current Scratch note projection.

projection.description: Current container value derives from selected note records; origin and sourceValueHash identify the retained source.

LegacyOutbox.description: Historical declaration only. Preserve without replay; it lacks the complete reviewed command and integrity bindings required by version 2.

DurableOutbox.description: App-owned pending command. Version 3 retains explicit record, prompt and folder intents before review. A matching review must be durably stored before publication. Strict transaction completion acknowledges local persistence only. Hash and receipt bindings are verified by the shared runtime; completed records are retained.

ErrorResponse.description: Stable machine code and safe user message. Preserve pending work; the caller explicitly reviews or retries instead of assuming an automatic retry is safe.

CommitRequest.description: Four fields identify the reviewed input. Full Preview responses remain accepted; extra response fields do not override the stored review. Idempotency-Key is required separately in the HTTP header. A committed retry uses its retained fingerprint and revision even after restart.
